title: Act: Add base typography and dialog/backdrop CSS to styles.css
summary: Add a base layer and the sf-fullscreen-bg and sf-dialog classes.
description: Edit src/styles.css to add body base rules, heading fonts, and shared classes for the full-screen backdrop and centered dialog used by later units.
acceptance_criteria: styles.css sets body background ink-1, color parchment-5, VT323 20px

steps.action: Insert base rules setting body background, colour, VT323 body font at 20px with line-height 1.3, and Press Start 2P for h1 and h2 with a smaller size.
steps.code:
body { background: var(--sf-color-ink-1); color: var(--sf-color-parchment-5); font-family: var(--sf-font-body); font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.3; }
h1, h2 { font-family: var(--sf-font-pixel); font-size: var(--sf-size-md); line-height: 1.5; margin: 0 0 var(--sf-space-2); }
steps.expected: Every page has dark background, light text and VT323 body font.

steps.action: Append .sf-fullscreen-bg (fixed-size full viewport, centered flex, wall.png cover backdrop over ink-1, pixelated) and .sf-dialog (width min(90vw, 640px), max-height 60vh, overflow-y auto, padding var(--sf-space-4)).
steps.code:
.sf-fullscreen-bg { min-height: 100vh; width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--sf-color-ink-1) url('/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/room/wall.png') center / cover no-repeat; image-rendering: pixelated; }
.sf-dialog { width: min(90vw, 640px); max-height: 60vh; overflow-y: auto; padding: var(--sf-space-4); }
steps.expected: Both classes exist and can be applied by components.
